hypothesis: Training the E005 CNO recipe with L_rel + 0.3 L_mean + 0.3 L_fluct + 0.1 L_TKE will beat E013 persist-first-4 on Fold A Rel-L2 and MVPE with at most 1.0 TKE regression.

data.normalization: unchanged E003/E005 per-channel Gaussian statistics over every training-window element

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update; no validation-based early stopping

success_criteria.sps: reported on the frozen E006 interval; excluded from the loss-ablation gate

controls_held_equal_to_e005: 64 E002 training trajectories and bad-file exclusion
seed, shuffle order, batch size, and update count
optimizer, learning rate, scheduler, precision, and no gradient clipping
controls_changed_from_e005: loss is L_rel + 0.3 L_mean + 0.3 L_fluct + 0.1 L_TKE
evaluation scores raw CNO and persist-first-4 with the frozen interval
promotion: evidence only; package only if the Fold A persist-first-4 gates pass, then confirm Fold B before any submission
limitations: TKE relative L2 is O(1) while L_rel is O(0.02), so lambda_tke=0.1 can dominate late training.
L_mean is the full-field temporal mean, not the official MVPE probe stencil.
No log-spectrum term in this run.
Fold C is not loaded. E016 may be ranked only on Fold A.
Codabench scores are not used. Persist-first k and the interval stay frozen.
